facts.text: SingleQuditDevice is the PennyLane Device subclass for the single-qudit remote backend
DjangoDevice is the base class for devices that call an external server
SingleQuditDevice constructs with one wire and the given number of shots
The default control-server URL is http://qsimsim.synqs.org/api/singlequdit/
pre_apply resets the device and builds experiment_0 with an instructions array, num_wires, shots and wire_order interleaved
apply maps RLX, RLZ, RLZ2 and Load through _operation_map and appends the encoded instruction to the job payload
The operation encoders write [0] as the wire, wrap the RLX and RLZ angles modulo 2*pi, and set qdim to par[0] + 1 for Load
sample appends a measure instruction, posts the payload to url_prefix + post_job/ and stores the returned job_id
check_job_status GETs url_prefix + get_job_status/ with the job id, username and password and raises SyntaxError when the status is ERROR
wait_till_done sleeps two seconds between get_job_status/ polls and stops only on DONE
sample fetches url_prefix + get_job_result/ and reads results[0].data.memory as integer shots
reset only clears the local qdim, job_id and job_payload
The README describes experiments controlled by the Labscript Suite through a JSON interface
The README describes interacting fermions in two optical tweezers
The README points real hardware to the labscript-qc repository

operator_required.name: run_experiment
operator_required.reason: no text file of the clone states one range for the operation parameter: it is an angle for RLX, RLZ and RLZ2 and a qudit-dimension offset for Load (single_qudit_ops.py:58-113). The operation encoders wrap the angles modulo 2*pi and pass the Load offset to qdim = par[0] + 1; the clone states no safe bound for the server experiment, so the site supplies the range of its deployment

operator_required.name: run_experiment
operator_required.reason: the constructor default shots=1 is a default, not a device bound (single_qudit_device.py:40-48); no text file of the clone states a shot-count range or a server-side limit, so the site supplies the range of its deployment

safe_state.description: no safe state is available: the clone exposes no stop, cancel or abort route for a submitted job, so a posted experiment runs to completion on the control server and reset() only clears local Python state
